note: Words for Tower Rescue: Quake Control V0.1 (one repair). The numbers on screen come from the item's prompt (needed and present power), never from these words, so no line can give the answer away. Placeholders: {system} a system's name; {needed}, {present} the prompt's power.

clues.text: The lift that carries boxes, not people, has stopped.
The lift that people ride has stopped. The box lift still works.
The fans are fine. The lift that people do not ride has stopped.

lines.intro: Safety drill! The tower just finished a pretend earthquake test. Everyone is safe.
lines.diagnose: Read the report. Tap the system that stopped.
lines.wrongSystem: The {system} is running fine. Read the report again.
lines.repair: It needs {needed}. It has {present}. Install one power cell to fill it exactly.
lines.gap: Look at the gap between {present} and {needed}.
lines.powerBar: Count up the power bar from {present} to {needed}.
lines.tooLow: Not enough power yet. The cell popped back out. Try another one.
lines.tooHigh: Too much power! The safety switch popped the cell out. Try a smaller one.
lines.testDone: It works! The {system} is back in service.
